text:
michelle: Heads up — the Getting Started Python page's async example is failing for me.
nguyen: Can you paste the link?
michelle: https://docs.redwood.ai/getting-started/python — the "Async client" snippet looks off. It's using `Redwood()` and not using an async context manager. Here's what I copied: 
```python
from redwood import Redwood
import os

async def main():
    client = Redwood(os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'])
    resp = await client.chat.create(model="gptx", input="hello")
    print(resp)
```
michelle: Running it errors with: `TypeError: 'Redwood' object is not awaitable` (stack trace points to client.chat.create awaiting sync client).
samir: Oof — that's the old sync class name. We renamed the async class to `RedwoodClient` in v0.9 and updated most pages, but looks like this page slipped.
devx-bot: Created issue #2314 in docs (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/2314) and attached the failing snippet. PR preview available: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2314/files
nguyen: Also FYI the "Python SDK reference" link from the sample-app README 404s (the README points to /reference/python which redirects to an outdated slug). I hit that while trying to update the sample app snippets.
michelle: Proposed quick fix in the snippet: 
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
import os

async def main():
    async with RedwoodClient(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY']) as client:
        resp = await client.chat.create(model="gptx", input="hello")
        print(resp)
```
michelle: That runs fine locally. Also added a short comment about sync vs async usage.
samir: I'll merge the minimal docs fix. We should also add a short note in the migration guide about class renames and a checklist for scanning sample repos for `from redwood import Redwood`.
docops: tagging @michelle for a quick review once PR is ready :eyes:
michelle: Thanks! One UX ask: can we add snippet execution to docs CI so these regressions get caught automatically? Even a lightweight runner that executes examples in a sandbox would help.
samir: Good idea — filing a follow-up RFC/issue to prototype snippet CI and add it to the docs pipeline. I'll reference #2314.
michelle: :thumbsup:
nguyen: Leaving a note in the sample-app repo to update snippet links once the docs PR is merged.
michelle: great, appreciate the quick triage everyone!
